openapi.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted object keys; compact separators; Unicode unescaped

candidate_endpoints.description: OpenAPI operations published in RC2 and unchanged in RC3 but not integrated into the App. See each reason; static publication does not establish live behavior, project ownership, retry safety, provenance, or an available real executor.

published_not_exposed.reason: Run-scoped persisted paired records are separate from project-scoped Study/Arm resources; no App authorization mapping is implemented.
Upstream list is global and has limit only; App has no project-scoped study ownership mapping or live verification.
Study lookup is not project-scoped upstream; App has no verified ownership mapping.
Read remains unexposed until project ownership and live behavior are verified.
Hash integrity is not trusted timestamping, provenance verification, or live validation.
New in rc2; no live identity response verified.
New in rc2; documented query-only reconciliation but not live validated or exposed by the App.
Real execution requires a validated paired_executor; upstream production create_app rejects direct paired_executor injection and WARDEN Live remains BLOCKED.
Intervention execution is run-scoped, requires approval/policy gates, and has no verified real executor or Study/Arm mapping.
Preregistration schema is published, but the App has no project mapping and POST idempotency; live behavior is NOT_RUN.
Analysis accepts caller-supplied outcome arrays; refs and hashes are not independent proof of data provenance.

not_published.reason: RC2 exposes workflow/run cancellation under different resource identities; there is no Loop-scoped cancellation operation and the App does not map cancellation across those identities.

candidate_endpoints.not_published_note: Absence is recorded only for explicit resource-scoped operations checked in the RC2 OpenAPI inventory; other cancellation operations under different resource identities are not treated as equivalent.

known_semantics.readiness: layered checks[] with status available/unknown/blocked per capability; source-tagged
known_semantics.options: per-mode submittable flag + blockers[] (NO_THREAT_CONTRACTS, COMPONENT_UNAVAILABLE:...) - the create form must render these verbatim
known_semantics.request_id: X-Request-ID echoed; local workflow registration idempotent per request_id
known_semantics.pagination: Loop list: items/count(current page)/offset/limit/next_offset; strategy evaluation list: items/count(current page)/offset/limit without next_offset
known_semantics.loop_idempotency: X-Loop-Idempotency-Key is mandatory; same key and same payload returns the registered Loop, changed payload returns 409 LOOP_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
known_semantics.strategy_evaluation_artifacts: Persisted index/detail reads only; missing artifact returns 410 EVALUATION_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE; null metrics remain unknown
known_semantics.defense_execute: compatibility entry; executor missing => honest unsupported response
